name: MPC Rate Bridge
author: krimple
summary: Use a USB audio interface that can't run at 44.1 kHz (a 48 kHz-only Quad Cortex mini, for one) as the MPC's audio device: the interface runs at its own rate and alsa-lib's rate converter sits in between. Pick it in Preferences > Audio; it then carries MPC's inputs and outputs. Tested on a Key 61 (Gen1, 3.10.1).
